name: Tofu Wrap with Curried Pineapple-Apricot Chutney & Mixed Greens

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pineapples
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Cut off skin from each pineapple; quarter, core, and small dice the flesh. Place half in a medium saucepan. (Place the remaining pineapple in a large bowl and set aside for later use.)
Small dice apricots and add to the pan with the pineapple.

Add water, vinegar, sugar, and spices to the pan. Stir to combine the chutney and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup water
⅓ cup apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp curry powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, medium dice tofu and place in another large bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp cornstarch
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add tofu and cook, turning every few minutes, until golden brown and crispy, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
While the tofu is cooking, add oil, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the pineapple. Stir to combine the salad dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the mixed greens, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Place tortillas on a flat surface; spread each with a layer of mayo and chutney. Top with tofu and a small portion of salad. Roll tightly to close. (Reserve remaining salad for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 large flour tortillas
3 tbsp vegan mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Cut wraps in half and divide between plates. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!
